name: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / PUC / Senior Secondary examination in any stream with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks (Mathematics / Computer Science / Statistics preferred).
overview: A comprehensive undergraduate program that imparts robust foundations in programming languages, computer systems, modern web architectures, database design, and software engineering methodologies.
highlights: Core mastery of C, C++, Java, Python, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
Relational and NoSQL database modeling with SQL, MongoDB, and Redis
Systematic software development life cycle, Agile methods, and DevOps pipelines
Experiential lab assignments and a semester-long industry capstone project

name: BCA (Honours / Honours with Research)
eligibility: 10+2 with minimum 55% aggregate, or transition eligibility for 3-year BCA students meeting the academic CGPA threshold under NEP guidelines.
overview: An advanced 4-year research-intensive program conforming to the National Education Policy (NEP 2020). Features deep specialization coursework, direct research mentorship, and a full-year dissertation or industrial fellowship.
highlights: Independent research dissertation under faculty mentorship with publishable outcomes
Advanced subjects: Neural Networks, Cloud Distributed Systems, Quantum Foundations
Extended 6-month corporate internship or startup incubation tenure
Direct eligibility for 1-year Master’s programs or global PhD doctoral applications
